theme_central: The reality of the resurrection: Allah, closer to man than his jugular vein, records every word through two recording angels — nothing that has been will be lost.
sources_note: Precisely sourced division (medium.com/@louismorris, grokipedia): 1-4, 5-11, 12-14/15, 15-25 (jugular vein v.16), 30-31, 38, 39-40, 41-44.

branches.title: Astonishment, doubt about the resurrection
branches.resume: Astonishment of the disbelievers at a warner from among themselves, denial of such a return.

children.t: Astonishment of the disbelievers, denial of the resurrection deemed impossible

branches.title: Blessings, signs of creation
branches.resume: The sky without flaw, the earth spread out, the palm trees with their stacked clusters.

children.t: The flawless sky, the spread-out earth, palm trees and vegetation

branches.title: Ancient peoples who denied
branches.resume: The people of Nuh, Thamud, 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brothers of Lot, the people of the Wood, the people of Tubba'.

children.t: Ancient peoples who denied their messengers, wearied by the first creation?

branches.title: Allah's closeness, the recording angels
branches.resume: Allah closer to man than his jugular vein; two angels record every word.

children.t: Allah closer than the jugular vein, two recording angels note every word
The agony of death, removal of the veil, the angel who drives and who testifies

branches.title: Dispute, Hell and Paradise
branches.resume: Dispute of the demon companion with the damned, Hell and Paradise brought near.

children.t: Dispute of the demon companion with the damned before Allah
Hell filling up, Paradise brought near to the pious

branches.title: Promise to the pious, creation, prayer
branches.resume: Promise to the attentive heart, creation of the heavens and the earth in six days, patience and prayer.

children.t: Promise to the pious, a reminder for whoever has an attentive heart
Creation in six days without fatigue, patience and glorification at the hours of prayer

branches.title: The Day of emerging from the graves
branches.resume: The Cry, the earth splitting open, swift emergence from the graves; closing, the Prophet is not a compeller.

children.t: The Cry announcing the emergence from the graves, the splitting earth
Closing: the Prophet is not a compeller, remind through the Qur'an
